_meta.name: gamma_glm
_meta.description: Gamma regression: REG_GLM with family=gamma + link=inverse models a strictly-positive continuous outcome whose conditional mean is a reciprocal-linear function of the predictors. Sibling family to Poisson (15_poisson.json) — Gamma fits continuous skewed positives (income, claim sizes, durations) where Poisson would over-restrict variance. The canonical Gamma link is inverse (the GLM theory's natural link); v1 reserves link=log as a future implementation. Uses customers.pulse income (a strictly-positive log-normally distributed outcome — the canonical Gamma fit target).
